{{Quote|Showtime, ''Boba''! We're coming up to the facility!|[[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="Mandalorian Memories">{{TCWComicCite|6.41|Mandalorian Memories}}</ref>}}
The '''Jedi Research Facility''' was a research installation that was operated by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in [[Timira City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], two relics believed to be rare [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] artifacts were discovered on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Korasa]] and taken to the Jedi Research Facility to be studied, though the artifacts were in fact fake. Word of the discovered reached the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] criminal underworld and two rival [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Korasa job|ventured]] to the facility to steal the artifacts. After releasing some [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|buzz droids]] to stage a diversion, the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and [[C-21 Highsinger/Legends|C-21 Highsinger]] made off with the relics, while their rivals [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] and [[Latts Razzi/Legends|Latts Razzi]] were captured by the research facility's guards.
